tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidders need to upload all the documents mentioned in tender document and schedule.
Tenderer reserve the right either to reject a bidder or to cancel the bid.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should provide satisfactory letter of similar items supplied satisfactorily from any government departments for the past 3 years.
The Bidder shall enclose a copy of MSME OR PMT OR Udyam Registration Certificate of the unit
The Bidder should enclose ISI/BIS Certificate/ISO issued to bidder OR to company or to society (or bidder should get authorization letter from concerned manufacturer/Aurthorised Dealer/supplier.
The bidder should be a Manufacturer OR Letter from authorized dealer, if he is not a manufacturer
The Bidder should upload the acknowledgement copy for submission of samples in the tender

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- acknowledgement copy for submission of samples

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Self-declaration for not blacklisted with any Government department in Rs 100 /- Judicial bond paper
The Tenderer should upload the Registration Certificate from the Department of Labour
The Tenderer should upload the Service authorization letter with service center details for the sewing machine supplied to the TIA, From the OEM/Authorized Dealer with Tender Number and Date.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- OEM authorization letter with service center details

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should produce registration certificate. In case of bidder is a partnership firm, partnership deed registered from the registrar of firms and incase of private limited company/limited company, ROC registration certificate must be upload. For Sole Proprietor GST certificate is enough.
The Bidder shall enclose a copy of Income Tax Returns for the last three financial years
The Bidders shall enclose a copy of Balance Sheet( with UDIN no),for the last 3 financial years

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Balance Sheet( with UDIN no)

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Turnover Statement for the last 3 financial years.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder shall enclose GST Registration Certificate. And Last 3 Years GST returns filed
Tenderer should upload the copy of the solvency certificate for sewing machine tender for Rs.50% of the Tender value issued by nationalized bank mention in the tender number & date
